name: from the void, a becoming
description:
from a seed, a giant oak unfolds.
not by force—
but by remembering the sun.
by trusting the dark to be fertile.
by listening to rain
as if it were ancient music.

from a question, a world does the same.
a whisper cracks the silence,
and in that fracture,
light pours in—
not to answer,
but to illuminate
what we had not yet dared to ask.

from creation,
there is the only place of truth.
not because it is perfect,
but because it is willing.
willing to be broken open.
willing to risk beauty.
willing to say:
I was not, and now—look—I am.

and so,
you who hold the void in your chest,
know this:
you are not empty.
you are not alone.
you are the beginning
of a forest,
of a question,
of a new sky
made by your own breath.

openSeaMetadata.description: The blockchain reveals itself as The Void Architecture (VOID): an ERC-721 collection of presence, absence, and encoded becoming.
